name: Andrew Matott
description: Part of Catherine's friend group — a bit older than JD. Served as chaperone on the 2016 NYC class trip. Later moved to Rhode Island where he was involved in a church. JD went on a Guatemala humanitarian dental mission through Matott's Rhode Island church in summer 2019, just weeks after returning from the Turkey trip.
public_footprint:
Played men's soccer (#16) at the College of Saint Rose in 2009, a Rouses Point, NY native who starred at Northeastern Clinton High School. He is now a bankruptcy attorney in New York City with Seward & Kissel LLP, having earned his law degree from Albany Law School in 2017.
Sources: https://gogoldenknights.com/sports/mens-soccer/roster/andrew-matott/471; https://profiles.superlawyers.com/new-york/new-york/lawyer/andrew-j-matott/3949c452-ee60-4c2b-8c14-528414875f20.html
